note: Cities with a page, by Census place GEOID (state FIPS + place code). Each row was read by hand on the city's own site on the day `read` names; only https links to the city's own pages, never a page for one parcel. A city needs a `permits` and a `zoning` row. `county` is the county the city's page sits under (most of the city is in it; `other_counties` says parts of the city are in other counties). `built` and `value` are the Census's medians for the city, filled by build-data.cjs.

sources.homes: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates, tables B25035 (median year structure built) and B25077 (median value, owner-occupied housing units), place geography

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Gainesville Building Division
rows.line: Takes permit applications online through PermitGNV, by email, by mail or in person; its PermitGNV portal also shows existing permits.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Gainesville?
rows.a: The City of Gainesville's Building Division issues building permits. Applications go in online through PermitGNV, by email, by mail or in person, and the PermitGNV portal also shows existing permits.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Gainesville Planning Division
rows.line: Holds each development to the city's Comprehensive Plan and Land Development Regulations; a Planner of the Day answers planning questions.
rows.q: Where is Gainesville's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Gainesville's Planning Division applies the city's Comprehensive Plan and Land Development Regulations to each development, and its Planner of the Day answers planning questions.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Kissimmee Building Division, Permits & Inspections
rows.line: Most home projects still need a permit under Florida's rules that took effect July 1, 2026, and the City must be told first even when one isn't needed; the Building Division works under the Florida Building Code.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Kissimmee?
rows.a: The City of Kissimmee's Building Division issues building permits under the Florida Building Code. Under Florida's rules that took effect July 1, 2026, most home projects still need a permit, and the City must be told first even when one isn't needed.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Kissimmee, Planning & Zoning
rows.line: Finds a property's zoning category online; the Development Code sets the use and design rules, and use and plan reviews are applied for here.
rows.q: Where is Kissimmee's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Kissimmee's Planning & Zoning pages find a property's zoning category online. The city's Development Code sets the use and design rules for development, and use and plan reviews are applied for there.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Tampa, Construction Services
rows.line: Issues every building permit and inspection for development inside the city.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Tampa?
rows.a: The City of Tampa's Construction Services Division reviews plans, issues building permits and inspects construction for property inside the city.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Tampa, Zoning Maps
rows.line: An interactive map of zoning districts inside the city limits; the zoning code is Chapter 27 of the city code.
rows.q: Where is Tampa's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Tampa's zoning maps show the zoning district of each property inside the city limits, by address. The zoning code itself is Chapter 27 of the City of Tampa Code.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Saint Paul Safety and Inspections, Building Permits & Inspections
rows.line: Needed to build, add to or change a one- or two-family home or any other building in the city.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Saint Paul?
rows.a: The City of Saint Paul's Department of Safety and Inspections issues building permits in the city, for building, adding to or changing a home or any other building.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Saint Paul Safety and Inspections, Zoning Permits and Land Uses
rows.line: Zoning approval comes before a building permit; design standards are in chapter 63 of the city's zoning code.
rows.q: Where is Saint Paul's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Saint Paul's Department of Safety and Inspections reviews zoning, which a building permit, a license or a change of use needs first. The city's design standards are in chapter 63 of the Saint Paul Zoning Code.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Fayetteville Development Services, Permitting & Inspections
rows.line: Issues permits, reviews plans and inspects buildings under the North Carolina building codes; its public portals hold permit records, plans and inspection reports by address.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Fayetteville?
rows.a: The City of Fayetteville's Permitting & Inspections divisions issue building permits, review plans and inspect buildings in the city. Permit records, plans and inspection reports for an address are in its E-Development portal (from 2021) and Fayworx portal (2015 to 2021).

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Fayetteville Development Services, Planning & Zoning
rows.line: Reviews and approves land development under the city's Unified Development Ordinance and handles variance requests and historic districts.
rows.q: Where is Fayetteville's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Fayetteville's Planning & Zoning Division reviews and approves land development under the city's Unified Development Ordinance, and handles variance requests and its historic districts.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Canton Building / Code Enforcement, Permits / Licenses / Inspections
rows.line: Its online portal takes permit applications, schedules inspections and searches permits made since October 1, 2025; older permits are looked up by phone.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Canton?
rows.a: The City of Canton's Building / Code Enforcement office issues building permits. Its online portal takes applications, schedules inspections and searches permits made since October 1, 2025; older permits are looked up by calling the office.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Canton, Zoning
rows.line: A zoning permit comes before any new building, addition, deck, fence, shed, pool or sign; the office also says where uses are allowed and runs the Zoning Board of Appeals.
rows.q: Where is Canton's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Canton's zoning office issues the zoning permit needed before any new building, addition, deck, fence, shed, pool or sign, says what uses are allowed where, and runs the Zoning Board of Appeals for variances.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Gresham, Building Permits and Inspections
rows.line: Needed to build, enlarge, alter, repair or move a building or change its electrical, gas, mechanical or plumbing systems; services are at City Hall, and permit and land use records can be looked up.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Gresham?
rows.a: The City of Gresham issues building permits for building, enlarging, altering, repairing or moving a building and for its electrical, gas, mechanical and plumbing systems. Permit services are at Gresham City Hall, and permit and land use records can be looked up online.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Gresham Urban Design and Planning, Planner on Duty
rows.line: The interactive zoning map shows zoning designations and earlier permits; the Planner on Duty answers site-specific questions by email, phone or at City Hall.
rows.q: Where is Gresham's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Gresham's interactive zoning map shows a property's zoning designation and earlier permits, and the Planner on Duty answers site-specific planning questions by email, by phone or at City Hall.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Portland Permitting & Development, public records
rows.line: Building permit, land use review and code enforcement records for private property; many are online.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Portland?
rows.a: Portland Permitting & Development issues building permits in the city and keeps its building permit, land use review and code enforcement records. Its public records page says which are online and how to ask for the rest.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: Portland Permitting & Development, Zoning and Land Use
rows.line: The city's zoning code, its zoning maps and answers to common zoning questions.
rows.q: Where is Portland's zoning?
rows.a: Portland Permitting & Development's Zoning and Land Use pages hold the city's zoning code, its zoning maps and answers to common zoning questions.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Reading, Building and Trades Codes Enforcement
rows.line: Issues permits for new construction, alterations, renovations and repairs in the building, electrical, mechanical and plumbing trades, reviews plans and inspects the work.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Reading?
rows.a: The City of Reading's Building and Trades division issues permits for new construction, alterations, renovations and repairs, reviews building plans and inspects construction in the city, under Pennsylvania's Uniform Construction Code.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Reading, Zoning and Planning
rows.line: Interprets and enforces the Zoning Ordinance; a zoning permit is needed before building, moving or expanding a structure, and its zoning map shows each area's classification.
rows.q: Where is Reading's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Reading's Zoning and Planning office interprets and enforces the Zoning Ordinance and keeps the zoning map. A zoning permit is needed before building, moving or expanding a structure.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Dallas Planning & Development, Permitting & Inspections
rows.line: The city's building permits and inspections, with its forms, fees and certificates of occupancy.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Dallas?
rows.a: The City of Dallas Planning & Development Department issues building permits and inspects construction in the city. Its Permitting & Inspections page holds its forms, fees and certificates of occupancy.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Dallas, Zoning Map
rows.line: The city's interactive zoning map; the city notes it is not a surveyor's data.
rows.q: Where is Dallas's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Dallas's interactive zoning map shows the zoning of each property in the city. The city notes the map is not data certified by a land surveyor.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Bellevue Development Services, Permits
rows.line: Reviews plans and issues permits for construction and land uses, from residential building to demolition, grading and trade permits; the process runs from application through plan review to inspections.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Bellevue?
rows.a: The City of Bellevue's Development Services reviews plans and issues permits for construction projects and land uses in the city, including residential building, demolition, grading, electrical, mechanical and plumbing permits.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Bellevue Development Services, Zoning Requirements
rows.line: The Land Use Code sets zoning designations, dimensional limits such as height and setbacks, and design standards; the city advises checking a property's zoning and allowed uses before buying.
rows.q: Where is Bellevue's zoning?
rows.a: Bellevue's Land Use Code, administered by Development Services, sets zoning designations, dimensional limits such as building height and setbacks, and design standards. The city advises finding out what a property is zoned and what uses are allowed before buying it.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Seattle Department of Construction and Inspections, Research a Project, Permit, or Property
rows.line: How to find a property's permit history, older permits and site records, gathered on one page.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Seattle?
rows.a: The Seattle Department of Construction and Inspections issues building permits in the city. Its Research a Project, Permit, or Property page says where to find a property's permit history and site records.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: Seattle Department of Construction and Inspections, Zoning
rows.line: Zoning districts are adopted by ordinance and shown on the city's official land use map.
rows.q: Where is Seattle's zoning?
rows.a: Seattle's Zoning Code sets how land is used and developed in the city. Its zoning districts are adopted by ordinance and shown on the city's official land use map; the Department of Construction and Inspections explains them.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Tacoma Planning and Development Services, Tacoma Permits
rows.line: The city's permit office; its Tacoma Permits system submits and searches permits online.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Tacoma?
rows.a: The City of Tacoma's Planning and Development Services issues building permits in the city. Its Tacoma Permits site submits and searches permits online.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Tacoma Planning and Development Services, Zoning
rows.line: Zoning is set in Chapter 13.06 of the Tacoma Municipal Code; the city's tMap shows a property's zoning by address or parcel.
rows.q: Where is Tacoma's zoning?
rows.a: Tacoma's zoning is set in Chapter 13.06 of the Tacoma Municipal Code. The city's interactive map, tMap, shows a property's zoning district by address or parcel number.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Vancouver, Residential Building Permits
rows.line: Needed to build, add to, alter, repair or demolish a home; one to six homes on a lot go through this permit.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Vancouver?
rows.a: The City of Vancouver issues building permits for homes inside the city: building, adding to, altering, repairing or demolishing one. Its residential building permits page explains them and links to its online permit center.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Vancouver, Planning, Development and Zoning
rows.line: The city's updated Comprehensive Plan, zoning map and zoning code took effect on July 31, 2026.
rows.q: Where is Vancouver's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Vancouver's planning, development and zoning pages hold its zoning. Its updated Comprehensive Plan, zoning map and zoning code took effect on July 31, 2026.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Riverside Building & Safety, Permits
rows.line: Construction in the city needs a building permit; the city keeps permits as public records.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Riverside?
rows.a: The City of Riverside's Building & Safety Division issues building permits for construction in the city and keeps them as public records.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Riverside Planning, Zoning Code and Regulations
rows.line: The city's zoning is Title 19 of the Riverside Municipal Code, with its permitted uses table.
rows.q: Where is Riverside's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Riverside's zoning is Title 19 of the Riverside Municipal Code. The Planning Division's page links to it and to the table of uses each zone permits.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Stockton Building & Life Safety
rows.line: Takes, reviews and issues permit applications for work within city limits and inspects construction, plumbing, electrical and mechanical work.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Stockton?
rows.a: The City of Stockton's Building & Life Safety division takes and issues permit applications for work within city limits, reviews the plans and inspects the work on site.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Stockton Planning & Engineering, Zoning
rows.line: The Zoning Map divides the city into zones that set land uses and standards such as height, lot coverage, parking and setbacks; a rezoning goes before the Planning Commission and the City Council.
rows.q: Where is Stockton's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Stockton's Zoning Map divides the city into zones that set what land can be used for and standards such as height, lot coverage, parking and setbacks. A rezoning takes a Planning Application and public hearings before the Planning Commission and the City Council.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Santa Rosa, Building Permits
rows.line: Needed to build, enlarge, alter, repair, move or demolish a building, or to change its electrical, gas, mechanical or plumbing systems, unless the California Building Code exempts the work.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Santa Rosa?
rows.a: The City of Santa Rosa issues building permits for work on buildings and their electrical, gas, mechanical and plumbing systems in the city, unless the California Building Code exempts the work. Meetings with a permit technician are by appointment.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Santa Rosa, Find Your Zoning District
rows.line: The City's GIS map gives a parcel's zoning code, which leads to the land use and permit requirements for its district.
rows.q: Where is Santa Rosa's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Santa Rosa's GIS map shows the zoning code for an address; the code leads to the land uses and permit requirements of that zoning district.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: City of Boulder, Building Permits and Inspections
rows.line: Building, altering, enlarging, moving, repairing, removing or replacing any building or structure takes a permit; applications go in through the city's Customer Self-Service Portal.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Boulder?
rows.a: The City of Boulder issues building permits; building, altering, enlarging, repairing or removing any building or structure takes one. Applications go in through the city's Customer Self-Service Portal, which also searches earlier permits.

rows.title: Zoning
rows.office: City of Boulder, Zoning
rows.line: Each zoning district combines three modules of the zoning code: use, form (setbacks, coverage, height) and intensity (lot size, open space, density).
rows.q: Where is Boulder's zoning?
rows.a: The City of Boulder's zoning districts regulate the uses and development of each property. Each district combines three parts of the zoning code: use, form (setbacks, building coverage, height) and intensity (lot size, open space, density).
